findings.title: Hidden execution breakpoint path panics before any qualified wait-return stop
findings.detail: The source records ?/T05, Z1,772b3bfc,1/OK, c, then no receive packet. Fixed VMware log records both vCPU debugReg.c:287 NOT_IMPLEMENTED panics adjacent to this loopback connection, with Workstation 16 build16894299, Hyper-V CPUID, ULM and hideBreakpoints TRUE. This environment/path is negatively qualified. OK acknowledges registration only; it does not prove a working trap or guest DR preservation.

findings.title: The 0.328-second marker is cleanup interrupt, not independently timed panic latency
findings.detail: The transcript timestamps c at56861.578 and cleanup interrupt at56861.906. Exception time is not separately recorded. Say reset occurred before cleanup/no wait stop; do not claim exact panic latency from this marker.

findings.title: Idle state mapping is not true wait-return evidence
findings.detail: Recomputed both CPU24-register comparisons remain exact, and v3 CPU tag layout matches v2. Those sources are idle kernel stops. They cannot establish helper/original-game wait return, native post-FXSAVE equality, allCPU pinned-counter freeze, restored resource lifetime or guest DR/code/context unchanged.

findings.title: Four x87 pointer fields and 32-bit descriptor representation remain unresolved
findings.detail: Default decoder keeps FIP/FDP/FCS/FDS absent. FXSAVE pointer mode requires explicit evidence. Full64 descriptor bases are retained with Unicorn32 truncation gap. canonical57_mapping_complete is only a mapping flag when caller selects a mode, not ABI acceptance; accepted/fullstate/fullABI stay false.

findings.title: Offline decoders require externally authenticated source bytes
findings.detail: Their raw SHA checks detect inconsistency against a supplied digest, not malicious coordinated replacement of bytes+digest. Header/report consistency is not cryptographic binding to original VM file or paused epoch. Current reports validate externally retained gzip/source identities; future acceptance must preserve that outer binding and epoch contract.

findings.title: No additional blocking parser defect found for the reviewed negative conclusion
findings.detail: Reviewed bounded reads, frame checksum/escaping, XML register widths, whole-register g prefixes, exact p width rejection, duplicate CPU tag retention, required-tag uniqueness, unknown-profile rejection, original raw reparse and explicit false acceptance. The v2 profile extension preserves actual magic/version/reserved without changing the frozen v1. No parser/source modification was made during review.

unreviewed_followup: Parent VM recovery, no-observer fixture baseline and shutdown occur after this static review and require their own evidence; no claim here about those outcomes.
